title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 repository CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, 9/9 Palomar module headers, zero-warning lake build --wfail KS Solution, bidirectional soundness & completeness KS.isColoringBool_iff promoted as Comparator Target 7, 38 explicit #print axioms + 126-theorem-constant Lean.collectAxioms audit in module mode [71 hand-written theorems] in KS/Audit.lean, live CI tamper-injection negative gate, independent lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, strengthened K1 explicit-basis + 0/1-colouring non-vacuity & K2 kernel-proved false-variant refutations, and 7 comparator targets checked by official Lean kernel (default & paranoid) + lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron via lake comparator --paranoid in CI run 46055062154, SLSA attestation #73248201; Release v2.3.0 run 46055716324 SLSA #73248523)

core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, with zero-Mathlib Lean 4 kernel proofs for the |c|<=2 pool (31) and the 4D pool (18) (including bidirectional KS.isColoringBool_iff soundness/completeness, strengthened explicit-basis + 0/1-colouring non-vacuity, and kernel-proved false-variant refutations); the other seven values rest on SAT unsatisfiability proofs checked by verify/drup_check (cross-checked in Linux CI by pinned drat-trim -> LRAT -> lrat-check and HOL4-formally-verified cake_lpr across 11 UNSAT/uniqueness proofs spanning 6 of 9 pools and ALL 3 dimensions d in {3,4,5}: B(3,2) k=30 & k=31 uniq, B(4,1) k=17 & k=18 uniq, B(3,3) k=30 & k=31 uniq, U(3,6) k=32 & k=33 uniq, U(3,12) k=32 & k=33 uniq, and 5D B(5,1) branch in:0,1,2;out:3,4 k=28), a CNF encoder, and paper lemmas.
verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18), bidirectional soundness & completeness KS.isColoringBool_iff, strengthened K1 non-vacuity theorems (requiring an explicit complete d-ray orthogonal basis inside T plus an explicit 0/1 colouring via KS.isColoringBool), and K2 kernel-proved false-variant refutations (refute_box3h2_all_31_colorable, refute_box4h1_all_18_colorable) are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4.35.0 without Mathlib with 9/9 Palomar module headers under zero-warning lake build --wfail KS Solution (38 explicit #print axioms + 126-theorem-constant KS namespace axiom audit [71 hand-written], 0 disallowed axioms), guarded by a live CI tamper-injection negative gate, replayed independently by lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, and all 7 comparator targets plus their dependency closure passed 6 independent kernel runs (official Lean default and paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron) via lake comparator --paranoid in CI (run 46055062154, SLSA #73248201; Release v2.3.0 run 46055716324, SLSA #73248523). Trigger T2 independent UNSAT proof checkers (pinned marijnheule/drat-trim 2e3b2dc -> LRAT -> lrat-check + HOL4-formally-verified tanyongkiam/cake_lpr 033aad5 confirming s VERIFIED UNSAT + truncated-LRAT negative control on both checkers) cross-verify 11 UNSAT/uniqueness proofs across 6 pools spanning ALL 3 dimensions d in {3,4,5} live in Linux CI (B(3,2), B(4,1), B(3,3), U(3,6), U(3,12), and 5D B(5,1) branch in:0,1,2;out:3,4 k=28; B(3,4), U(3,18), U(3,24), and the remaining 82 5D branches rest on verify/drup_check). data/MANIFEST.sha256 is freshly timestamped by DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA (.tsr, OpenSSL X.509 Verification: OK in CI) and 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots), Software Heritage full snapshot swh:1:snp:4c421f5d8b6cf9d06c224ed7bfafe88bc3392f4f (v2.2.0; fresh v2.3.0 Save Code Now gated by Anubis PoW), zero-warning C11 ASan/LSan/UBSan engines, 59/59 Node checks, 128 Python tests (incl. 6/6 AST source-code mutants killed), 33/33 Crossref DOIs (0 retractions), 0.00pt overfull PDF, and Build Standard v1.2.0 98.4% (63/64, A24 partial for pinned >5 MB cut-certificate JSON). Unrestricted minimal-KS in R^3 (QM-011) remains open.
